meta.what: Real per-module post-hoc ablation on MoveBench v0 (n=1 sample).
meta.gt: data/v0/mb_v0_0001.json (32 macro segments, 64 subsegments, 959s, single annotator)
meta.grounded_pred: Exp4 two-stage skeleton+detail v3 run2 (25 segments)
meta.ungrounded_pred: multi-pass holistic VLM, no CV grounding (Exp2-family pass1, 39 segments)
meta.caveat: Single annotated sample; every delta is a single-sample developer measurement, not a leaderboard result. No CIs.
meta.tautology_excluded: The 50-video GT==prediction case is excluded everywhere.

M1_measurement_grounding.description: Headline with/without-harness contrast: CV-grounded two-stage prediction vs ungrounded multi-pass holistic VLM (no CV constraints). Both real, unedited outputs.

ungrounded_pathology.note: The ungrounded multi-pass output emitted DECREASING timestamps in its third window (e.g. 11:30->11:20), so 13/39 predicted spans are zero/negative-length and are clipped to nothing by the scorer. This is a real failure mode of the harness-free pipeline, and it is the main reason the ungrounded run matches only 1/32 GT positions.

M1_measurement_grounding.direction: CV-grounding is the headline win: it RAISES T1 macro-F1 ~9.7x (0.014 -> 0.136) and matched positions 1 -> 6 of 32. The ungrounded run's HIGHER mean matched IoU (0.875) is an ARTIFACT of matching only a single segment (n=1 matched), not better localization; read macro-F1 / matched-count as the load-bearing M1 metrics, not IoU.

M2_semantic_ontology_folding.description: Ontology equivalence folding (alias/synonym/hierarchy normalization) ON vs OFF, scored on the SAME Exp4 prediction. OFF = exact lowercased string match.
M2_semantic_ontology_folding.direction: Folding can only RAISE or hold matched-position F1 (it merges surface variants onto canonical ids). The measured delta on Exp4's position field quantifies how much the alias map is doing on this artifact.

M3_temporal_smoothing.description: Merge adjacent same-position micro-segments (deterministic stand-in for EMA-over-boundaries) on the ungrounded prediction. Measures oversegmentation ratio (pred/GT) and T1 macro-F1 before/after.
M3_temporal_smoothing.direction: Smoothing REDUCES the predicted-segment count toward GT granularity. On THIS artifact only 1 adjacent same-position pair exists (the multi-pass timeline interleaves positions and resets at window boundaries), so the merge is nearly inert (39 -> 38). The mean-IoU drop is a side-effect of that single merge widening one matched span; reported as measured, not inflated. The documented over-segmentation extreme for this pipeline family (Exp2 reached 241 segments, 7.5x GT) is NOT recomputed here because that 241-segment artifact is not in the converted prediction set.

M4_abstain_aware.description: Treat predicted unknown/occluded/paused spans as ABSTAIN (excluded from FP accounting) vs counting them as ordinary segments, on the ungrounded prediction.
M4_abstain_aware.direction: Abstain-aware removes non-committal spans so they cannot be scored as false positives; on this artifact only 1 span(s) are abstain, so the measured impact is small but its sign/magnitude is reported honestly.
M4_abstain_aware.note_if_small: If n_abstain is 0-1, this module is effectively inert on this single sample; reported as measured, not inflated.

M5_schema_constraint_violation_rate.description: Ontology-violation rate (fraction of predicted technique labels outside the v0 ontology) WITH folding vs WITHOUT, on the Exp4 prediction's labels (T3 oracle-segment regime, approximate index alignment).
M5_schema_constraint_violation_rate.direction: Schema-constraint folding LOWERS the apparent violation rate (canonical aliases get recognized as in-ontology) and can only hold-or-raise T3 F1. The delta quantifies the schema module's effect on this artifact.
M5_schema_constraint_violation_rate.note: T3 here is the same approximate oracle-segment alignment used in baselines.md (predictions are not GT-boundary-aligned), so read the violation-rate delta as the load-bearing M5 number and T3 F1 as directional.

derived_summary.note: Derived = arithmetic combination of the M1 direct measurements. Macro-F1 (not mean IoU) is the load-bearing harness headline: the ungrounded run's higher IoU comes from matching only 1 segment and must not be read as better localization.
